description:text: tsts -- sea water temperature (used in synoptic maps)
trtr -- original time period of rain obs. (trtr)
rhlc -- rel. humidity from low clouds
rhmc -- rel. humidity from middle clouds
rhhc -- rel. humidity from high clouds
apdss -- atmospheric path delay in satellite signal
cpt -- characteristic of pressure tendency (used in synoptic maps)
w2 -- past weather 2 (used in synoptic maps)
aerod -- aerosol optical depth at 0.55 microns
rao -- Ratio of fine mode to total aerosol optical depth at 0.55 microns
lnprc -- log(radar rain rate mm/h + epsilon)
max_wind_shear1 -- Wind shear above and below 1st maximum wind in sonde profile (s-1)
binary_snow_cover -- binary snow cover (0: no snow / 1: presence of snow)
potential_temp -- potential temperature (Kelvin) or theta -- [alias to $potential_temp]
rawbt_hirs -- Raw brightness temperature specific to HIRS (K)
rawbt_amsu -- Raw brightness temperature specific to AMSU (K)
rawbt_hirs20 -- Raw brightness temperature specific to HIRS (K)
radial_velocity -- Radial velocity from doppler radar
rawbt_amsr_89ghz -- Raw brightness temperature specific to AMSR 89GHz channels (K)
max_wind_shear2 -- Wind shear above and below 2nd maximum wind in sonde profile
lower_layer_p -- Pressure at bottom of layer SBUV (Pa)
upper_layer_p -- Pressure at top of later SBUV (Pa)
rawbt_mwts -- Raw brightness temperature specific to MWTS (K)
rawbt_mwhs -- Raw brightness temperature specific to MWHS (K)
